# ledger_exchange_rates (Data Source)

Locally cached currency-conversion rates with their provider, source, dates and staleness. Ledger never converts silently: a stale or missing rate is shown, not hidden.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Cached EUR to USD rates since the start of the year. Each rate keeps its provider, dates and staleness.
data "ledger_exchange_rates" "eur_usd" {
  base     = "EUR"
  quote    = "USD"
  date_gte = "2026-01-01"
}

output "stale_rates" {
  value = [for r in data.ledger_exchange_rates.eur_usd.items : r.date if r.stale]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `base` (String) Only rates with this base currency.
- `date_gte` (String) Only rates dated on or after this day (YYYY-MM-DD).
- `date_lte` (String) Only rates dated on or before this day (YYYY-MM-DD).
- `max_items` (Number) The most items to read (1 to 10000); 1000 when unset.
- `quote` (String) Only rates with this quote currency.
- `rate_provider` (String) Only rates of this provider.
- `source` (String) Only rates from this source.

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) The items, in the order the API lists them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))
- `truncated` (Boolean) True when the API had more items than max_items; narrow the filters or raise max_items.

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `base` (String) Base currency.
- `confirmed_through` (String) The latest date the provider confirmed it for.
- `date` (String) The date the rate is for.
- `first_retrieved_at` (String) When it was first retrieved.
- `previous` (Attributes) The value it was revised from, or null. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--previous))
- `quote` (String) Quote currency.
- `rate_provider` (String) The rate provider.
- `retrieved_at` (String) When it was last retrieved.
- `source` (String) The source.
- `stale` (Boolean) Whether it is stale.
- `stale_reason` (String) not_retrieved_recently or rate_date_too_old, or null.
- `value` (String) The rate: how many units of quote one unit of base buys, an exact decimal string.

<a id="nestedatt--items--previous"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.previous`

Read-Only:

- `revised_at` (String) When it was revised.
- `value` (String) The earlier value.
